profiles.name: Mohamad Sabu
profiles.position: Minister of Agriculture and Food Security; President of AMANAH
profiles.description: Mohamad Sabu is Minister of Agriculture and Food Security and represents Kota Raja in Selangor. He is President of Parti Amanah Negara (AMANAH), a component of Pakatan Harapan.

profiles.name: Nga Kor Ming
profiles.position: Minister of Housing and Local Government; Deputy Chairman of DAP
profiles.description: Nga Kor Ming is Minister of Housing and Local Government and Member of Parliament for Teluk Intan, Perak. He is Deputy Chairman of DAP, a component of Pakatan Harapan.

milestones.title: Raise rice self-sufficiency to 80% by 2030
milestones.description: Mohamad Sabu set an 80% rice self-sufficiency target for 2030 in remarks carried by the ministry’s November 2023 media archive.
milestones.progress_note: KPKM’s October 2026 statement, reported by BERNAMA after a meeting chaired by Mohamad, gives a 2025 rice self-sufficiency ratio of 54.3% and describes measures to protect padi land. This dated food-supply ratio is not a completion score. The target remains in progress, not achieved.

milestones.title: Reach 50% beef and buffalo-meat self-sufficiency by 2030
milestones.description: Mohamad Sabu reaffirmed a 50% beef/buffalo-meat self-sufficiency target for 2030 and described support for livestock investment and production.
milestones.progress_note: The minister’s December 2025 statement reported roughly 17% beef self-sufficiency for the preceding year. DOSM’s September 2026 release reports 82.6% beef import dependency for 2025. Import dependency is a different indicator; it is not converted into self-sufficiency or a completion percentage. The numerical completion field remains blank.

milestones.title: Provide one million affordable homes by 2035
milestones.description: At the launch of the National Housing Policy 2026–2035, Nga announced a target of one million affordable homes by 2035.
milestones.progress_note: The ministry release establishes the target and the policy launch. It does not establish delivery of one million homes. A target-specific delivery total was not verified in this batch, so outcome status and completion percentage remain unknown.

milestones.title: Increase Rumah Mesra Rakyat delivery to 10,000 homes a year
milestones.description: Nga said the annual Rumah Mesra Rakyat target would be raised to 10,000 homes through collaboration with government, private-sector and community partners.
milestones.progress_note: The announcement does not establish a particular calendar-year deadline or a completed annual delivery total. Those fields remain blank rather than turning an annual target into a dated achievement.

methodology: Editorial records of attributed commitments, not endorsements or independently audited political-performance scores. Outcome dates and review dates are distinct. Published sector metrics are not converted into completion scores. Year-only deadlines use year-end date markers.
